headline: Dow futures jump 600 points as Bessent says Strait of Hormuz deal imminent
summary: Dow futures rose about 600 points after US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz could come 'today or tomorrow.' Oil prices fell as much as 4%.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so developments there move crude prices and broader equity sentiment.
why_moved: Bessent's comment that a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz could come soon was cited, and oil fell as much as 4%. Lower oil costs and reduced disruption risk tend to lift equities.
